name: Beam Cloud On-demand - L40S PCIe
price_basis: per L40S PCIe machine-hour, on-demand, including 12 vCPU + 96 GB RAM + 1 TB NVMe. Fetched 2026-10-04. This is a per-machine rate for a single-GPU machine, so it is also the per-GPU rate. PRICE CLASS: this is a PUBLISHED LIST PRICE - an asking rate a new customer is quoted, not a realised, discounted or negotiated transaction rate. A real bill is at or below this and typically well below it once commitments, credits and committed-use discounts are applied.
notes:
Beam on-demand L40S at $0.76/hr is the cheapest published L40S rate from any managed provider. It is 66% below CoreWeave on-demand L40S ($2.25), 79% below Replicate ($3.51), and 58% below Paperspace (if Paperspace L40S were listed). The rate includes the full machine (12 vCPU, 96GB RAM, 1TB NVMe). Beam charges no egress fees. The L40S is a inference-optimized GPU with 48GB GDDR6 memory, well-suited for medium-size model inference.

 EXPORT CONTROL (2026-10-04, mechanism-level; sources spl-bis-2026-05-d5-guidance, spl-bis-2026-01-advanced-computing-case-by-case): renting capacity does NOT remove the export-control question, it relocates it. Providing remote access to controlled computing capability can constitute a transfer under the EAR, so the provider must screen the end user; and separately, under the 91 FR 1684 licence regime the consignee must run KYC procedures to prevent unauthorized remote access and must manage and limit IaaS access to the hardware - obligations pushed onto the customer, who must be told to implement them. For a customer headquartered or parented in Country Group D:5 or Macau the 742.6(a)(6)(iii)(A) end-user/parent test can bite even when the capacity is consumed in a permitted region. Recorded true because the underlying hardware is controlled and the provider carries the screening duty, not because access to a US region is itself restricted.

 LEAD TIME: null - and specifically because a PEER-TO-PEER marketplace has no lead time at all. Host nodes appear and disappear, so the availability a buyer sees is a snapshot of what some host posted on the observation date, not a schedulable delivery date. This is the widest availability uncertainty in the whole supply set and it is structural rather than a missing datum: it argues directly for the renting-over-buying decision this record feeds.
